title: UAP Metadata
description: Protocol metadata for discovery manifests and responses. Mirrors the UCP entity/registry pattern so that a participant implementing both protocols shares one discovery code path.

version.description: Version identifier in YYYY-MM-DD format. UAP has no semantic version numbers; a newer date MUST be backward compatible for 12 months or carry a distinct capability name.

version_constraint.description: Version range requirement with minimum and optional maximum.

max.description: Maximum compatible version (inclusive). When absent, no upper bound.

role.description: The acting role for a message. A deployment MAY implement several roles; every request declares the one it is acting as. See SPEC.md §2.

profile.description: Conformance profile. uap.core is REQUIRED by all others. See SPEC.md §3.

entity.description: Shared foundation for all UAP entities (capabilities, services, handlers).

spec.description: URL to the human-readable specification section.

schema.description: URL to the JSON Schema defining this entity's payloads.

id.description: Instance identifier, to disambiguate multiple configurations of the same entity.

config.description: Entity-specific configuration. Structure defined by the entity's own schema.

members.description: Members of the reserved `uap` protocol object. Open for forward compatibility: consumers MUST ignore unrecognized members, and every defined member MUST be safe to ignore — a participant that does not process it loses that member's benefit, never correctness.

map_order.description: Preferred key order for map-valued fields in the annotated scope. Advisory only.

integrity.description: Answer-integrity assertions travelling with an object. Never safe to ignore at settlement, but safe to ignore for rendering.

capabilities_registry.description: Capabilities keyed by reverse-domain name. Each value is an array so that multiple versions or configurations may be declared simultaneously.

payout_handlers_registry.description: Payout handlers keyed by reverse-domain name, e.g. dev.uap.payout.ap2, com.stripe.connect. Mirrors UCP's payment_handlers registry.

base.description: Base UAP metadata carried in the root `uap` envelope of a manifest or response.
